budget_proposal.failure_policy: preserve all completed and partial results; no replacement, overwrite or automatic parameter search

engineering_audit.fixed_single_view_policy: one common history frame for all candidate queries in a decision; audit every frame
engineering_audit.independent_replay: exact raw trajectory, sensors and task events
engineering_audit.public_geometry_recovery: required positive control before learning claims; separate R3 implementation

config.physics_reference_policy: copy declared physical constants into a new scene; do not mutate or load as the new scene

task_success.gate_attempt_rule: forward center-plane crossing starts attempt; center retreat below plane cancels; rear clearance completes same active attempt
